ios.desc:
KineVision helps coaches and athletes turn training footage into clear, actionable insights. Analyze technique, compare performances, and track progress over time.

• Record video analysis
Record high quality video analysis with microhopne audio and customizable face camera view.

• Slow Motion & Frame-by-Frame Playback
Break down movements with precision and spot details invisible at full speed.

• Drawing Tools & Annotations
Draw, mark, and highlight directly on the video to explain technique and corrections clearly.

• Advanced Skeleton Mode
Joint Angle measurement, Joint tracking

• Tags
Tag your videos to easily filter and find later. Use "Reference" tags for examplary videos.

• Team & Athlete management
Assign videos to athletes and quickly filter or share performance analyses.

• Camera
Professional sports camera with adjustable shutter speed and ISO. Auto-label captured videos by athletes.

• Stopwatches
Measure time between any two frames in the video. Works also in split view. 

• Versus Mode
Play two videos side-by-side, synced together, to compare technique, progress, or reference models.

• Save & Share
Securely store videos and easily share feedback with athletes, teammates, or clients.

• Track Progress
Organize clips over time to measure improvement and refine technique with confidence.

--------------------------------
KineVision free version is ad-free and truly free. You won't waste your time on ads. And you get all the features you expect: recording analysis, drawing over video, side-by-side comparison, and more.

KineVision Max unlocks powerful features and tools:
- AI Coach Assistant - only for Apple Intelligence supported devices
- Advanced camera controls (Shutter speed and ISO)
- Joint Tracking
- Custom skeleton with joint angles
- Laser and rectangle tools
- HQ Export options without watermark
- Auto hiding tools during editing
- Library customization
- Customizable face camera background

EULA https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
I'm building KineVision, a sport video analysis app for iOS. Something like Coach's Eye.

I wanted to have a more difficult project and learn more about AV and Liquid Glass. I try not to vibe-code.
I keep it 100% free for now, I'm looking for power users and retention. I won't monetise until I feel that this is a helpful tool.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kinevision-video-coaching/id6752237075
